extra_quotes: Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr. RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21%/17% with a 6% area reduction over commercial synthesis.
We present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that combines fine-grained timing analysis, parallel RTL exploration, sequential equivalence checking, and group-relative skill learning.
Across eight designs, commercial synthesis tuning improves average WNS/TNS by 7.4%/11.1%, while open-source algorithm discovery reduces area-delay product (ADP) by 18.7%.
We use Synopsys Design Compiler for commercial synthesis, the Nangate 45 nm standard-cell library [29], and Cadence JasperGold SEC [ 30] for verification.
Power is excluded from the current optimization objective because reliable power estimation requires workload-dependent switching activity.
